title: Where Are the Best Photo Spots on a Boat Trip Along Madeira's South Coast?
description: The best shots west of Funchal: Câmara de Lobos bay, Cabo Girão from below, Fajã dos Padres, Ribeira Brava and Ponta do Sol, and the light that suits each.
heroAlt: A guest seen from behind photographing the coast near Ribeira Brava from the bow in late light
keywords: best photo spots boat trip Madeira
Madeira south coast photography from a boat
Cabo Girão photo from the sea

images.prompt: Realistic photograph from the deck of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, late afternoon about an hour before sunset. A guest seen from behind in silhouette at the bow holds up a phone towards the coast near Ribeira Brava, Madeira: the town at the mouth of a deep green valley, the church tower, steep cliffs lit warm gold, calm sea with small glints. No face visible, natural colours, no text.
images.alt: A guest seen from behind photographing the coast near Ribeira Brava from the bow in late light

images.prompt: Realistic photo of the old stone pier of Ponta do Sol in Madeira with its wide round basalt arch, seen from a boat on the water in soft late afternoon light, village houses climbing the cliff behind.
images.alt: The 1849 stone pier with its round arch at Ponta do Sol, seen from the sea

images.prompt: Realistic photo of a phone in a hand with a wrist strap, framing Cabo Girão cliff on its screen in portrait mode, the real cliff blurred behind, on the deck of a boat, bright morning light, no face visible.
